title: Chuyên đề Dạng của động từ
summary: Tổng hợp ba dạng động từ To-inf, V-ing và Bare-inf: động từ đi kèm, cấu trúc với tân ngữ (ask/make/let), cụm cố định (look forward to, have trouble, prefer ... to ...) để làm chắc các câu chọn dạng động từ và tìm lỗi sai trong đề thi vào 10.

theory.heading: To-infinitive
points: Sau các động từ: want, decide, hope, plan, agree, refuse, promise, manage, learn, afford, offer, seem, pretend + to V.
V + O + to V: ask, tell, want, invite, advise, encourage, allow, remind, persuade + sb + to V.
It + be + adj + (for sb) + to V; too + adj + to V; adj + enough + to V.
Chỉ mục đích: (in order) to V. Sau từ để hỏi: know how/what/where + to V.

examples.en: The teacher encouraged us to read more English books.
examples.vi: Cô giáo khuyến khích chúng tôi đọc nhiều sách tiếng Anh hơn.

examples.en: It is important for teenagers to get enough sleep.
examples.vi: Ngủ đủ giấc rất quan trọng đối với thanh thiếu niên.

theory.heading: V-ing (Gerund)
points: Sau: enjoy, avoid, mind, finish, suggest, consider, practise, miss, keep, deny, admit, delay, risk, can't help, can't stand, give up.
Sau mọi giới từ: be good at, be keen on, be used to, look forward to, object to, instead of, without + V-ing.
Cụm cố định: have trouble/difficulty (in) + V-ing; spend time/money + V-ing; it's no use/no good + V-ing; be worth + V-ing; feel like + V-ing.
prefer V-ing to V-ing = would rather V than V; V-ing làm chủ ngữ: Swimming is good for health.

examples.en: I'm looking forward to seeing you again.
examples.vi: Tôi rất mong được gặp lại bạn.

examples.en: Many students have trouble getting up early.
examples.vi: Nhiều học sinh gặp khó khăn khi dậy sớm.

theory.heading: Bare infinitive (V nguyên mẫu không 'to')
points: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu: can, could, will, should, must, may, might + V.
Sau had better, would rather: You'd better stay at home.
make / let / have + sb + V: My mum made me tidy my room.
Bị động của make: be made + to V (He was made to apologise).

examples.en: My parents let me go to the cinema on Saturdays.
examples.vi: Bố mẹ cho phép tôi đi xem phim vào thứ Bảy.

examples.en: You had better wear a helmet when riding a motorbike.
examples.vi: Bạn nên đội mũ bảo hiểm khi đi xe máy.

theory.heading: Phân biệt 'to' là giới từ và 'to' của động từ nguyên mẫu
points: look forward to, be/get used to, object to, be committed to, when it comes to: 'to' là giới từ → + V-ing.
used to + V (thói quen trong quá khứ) khác be used to + V-ing (quen với).

examples.en: She is used to living in a big city now.
examples.vi: Bây giờ cô ấy đã quen sống ở thành phố lớn.

tips: Xác định từ đứng ngay trước chỗ trống: modal/make/let → V; giới từ → V-ing; động từ trong danh sách 'to V' → to V.
Gặp 'to' trước chỗ trống, tự hỏi: đây là giới từ cố định (look forward to, be used to) hay to-infinitive?
Cấu trúc 'prefer A to B' yêu cầu hai vế song song: prefer V-ing to V-ing.
Với dạng tìm lỗi sai, kiểm tra trước tiên các động từ ngay sau suggest, avoid, let, make, look forward to.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 1. Chọn dạng đúng của động từ
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the best option (A, B, C or D) to complete each sentence.

questions.question: The doctor advised my father ______ more exercise.
questions.explanation: advise + sb + to V → advised my father to do.

questions.question: My mother made me ______ the dishes after dinner.
questions.explanation: make + sb + V (nguyên mẫu không to) → made me wash.

questions.question: We are looking forward to ______ our pen friends in Australia.
questions.explanation: 'look forward to' – 'to' là giới từ → + V-ing: meeting.

questions.question: Many people have trouble ______ asleep because they use their phones late at night.
You had better ______ an umbrella. It's going to rain.
questions.explanation: had better + V nguyên mẫu không to → take.

questions.question: It's no use ______ about the past. Let's think about the future.
She spent the whole afternoon ______ for her lost keys.
questions.explanation: spend time + V-ing → spent the afternoon looking.

questions.question: The museum is really worth ______. You should go there.
The film was too boring for us ______ to the end.
questions.explanation: too + adj + (for sb) + to V → too boring for us to watch.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 2. Chọn câu đúng / tìm cách diễn đạt đúng
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence that is correct or closest in meaning to the given one.

questions.question: Choose the correct version of the sentence: 'I prefer reading books to watch TV in my free time.'

options.A: I prefer to read books to watching TV in my free time.
options.B: I prefer reading books to watching TV in my free time.
options.C: I prefer read books to watch TV in my free time.
options.D: I prefer reading books than watching TV in my free time.

questions.explanation: Cấu trúc prefer V-ing to V-ing (hai vế song song). A không song song; C sai dạng; D dùng 'than' thay vì 'to'.

questions.question: My parents allowed me to stay up late on New Year's Eve.

options.A: My parents let me to stay up late on New Year's Eve.
options.B: My parents let me staying up late on New Year's Eve.
options.C: My parents let me stay up late on New Year's Eve.
options.D: My parents made me stay up late on New Year's Eve.

questions.explanation: allow sb to V = let sb V (không to). A, B sai dạng; D 'made' nghĩa là bắt buộc nên sai nghĩa.

questions.question: Choose the sentence that is grammatically correct.

options.A: She suggested us to go camping at the weekend.
options.B: She suggested to go camping at the weekend.
options.C: She suggested going camping at the weekend.
options.D: She suggested go camping at the weekend.

questions.explanation: suggest + V-ing (hoặc suggest that + S + V). Không dùng suggest + to V hay suggest + sb + to V.

questions.question: Learning a foreign language is not easy.

options.A: It is not easy to learn a foreign language.
options.B: It is not easy learn a foreign language.
options.C: It is not easy for learning a foreign language.
options.D: It is easy not learning a foreign language.

questions.explanation: V-ing làm chủ ngữ ↔ It + be + adj + to V. B thiếu 'to'; C sai cấu trúc; D sai nghĩa.

questions.question: He is used to ______ up early because he works on a farm.
questions.explanation: be used to + V-ing (quen với việc) → getting. 'to' ở đây là giới từ.
